### He Will Hold Me Fast
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/he-will-hold-me-fast
Passage: Jude 1:24
Points:
- Believers often worry about whether their faith will hold out through life's trials.
- Endurance does not ultimately rely on our own human striving or willpower.
- God Himself is able to guard His people from stumbling and bring them to glory.
- The Lord does not sustain believers reluctantly, but preserves them with great joy.
- True spiritual security rests in being kept by God's powerful hand and delighted love.
